sampling: Paired iid uniform draws inside declared parameter ranges. Not experimental confidence intervals. No aggregate score across conflicting objectives.
scope_note: Twenty-four selected parameters include water binding energy and excess heat capacity, liquid relaxation, retention scale and liquid mobility. Permeability, pore radius, condensation factor and evaporation A/E remain fixed, as do liquid latent contrast and transition width. Eight paired samples do not establish all-parameter, sorption-heat, glass-yield or permeability-range robustness. Added sampled dimensions change other draws; cross-ensemble differences cannot be assigned to binding alone.
